strict_original_result.step_semantics: Actual collector steps in numeric order; not inferred token numbers
limitations: Null statistics remain unobservable; equality of hidden values is not established.
Later generated inputs can differ between B/F; this comparator does not infer their cause.
Step numbers and matching stacks do not independently prove request identity.
Statistical first difference does not uniquely establish a physical fault mechanism.

rules.identity: operator family + exact resolved source stack + exact construct entry
rules.uniqueness: exactly one record for that context on each side; repeated contexts are ambiguous
rules.order: all shared unique anchors must preserve relative order
rules.missing_context: missing/empty stack or missing construct refuses pairing; null construct is disclosed
rules.arguments: scalar argument changes keep invocation identity but forbid same-arguments attribution
rules.outputs: scalar output changes are observations, not argument identity changes
rules.tensor_statistics: only compare matching complete tensor descriptions; preserve null/nonfinite
rules.unpaired: retain every record and its surrounding shared anchors; never delete inserted calls
rules.global_first_difference: never supplied by this diagnostic; retain the unchanged strict report

limitations: No global first difference is inferred by diagnostic pairing
Shared callsite does not prove scheduler request mapping or producer-consumer storage identity
Unchanged argument descriptions/statistics do not establish complete input equality
Null and paired NaN are unobservable/uncomparable, never equality
Collector step numbers are preserved, not interpreted as decode tokens
